function: function: learned CNN only reconstructs target occupancy maps from backscattered downlink signals (p. 1, p. 10); precoder is zero-forcing and link unmodified (p. 6, p. 10).
notes: Reason function. The only learned element is the ResNet18-based CNN of the neural sensing estimator, which maps features of the estimated sensing CSI to discrete maps of spatial occupancy (scene reconstruction, i.e. target localization on a grid). p. 1: "our neural ISAC pipeline measures the backscattered communication signals to generate discrete map representations of spatial occupancy" and "without modifying the MIMO-OFDM communication link." p. 6: "since there are no learnable parameters in the communication link, the subproblem P1 does not need to be solved." p. 10, Algorithm 1: "Zero-forcing precoding", and only the CNN parameters are updated. The sensing channel estimator is classical (LS or Tikhonov-regularized LS, eq. 44, p. 9), so there is no learned channel estimation (area 2), no learned beams, waveforms, or resources of the ISAC system (area 5), and no symbol detection (area 1); scene reconstruction or target localization is an excluded sensing function. Earlier checks pass: research article, learned method, physical layer. Reviewer may confirm, since the system is ISAC (8 Tx and 8 Rx antennas, two single-antenna UEs, 6 GHz, Sionna ray tracing, p. 11) with quantitative results (accuracy, precision-recall break-even point, BCE loss, p. 13-16).
